steps.command:
ls -la /workspace
echo "=== ALICE ==="
cat /workspace/alice_calendar.ics
echo "=== BOB ==="
cat /workspace/bob_calendar.ics
echo "=== CAROL ==="
cat /workspace/carol_calendar.ics

sbx put meeting_scheduled.ics <<'EOF'
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Terminal-Bench//Meeting Scheduler//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-20240117@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240115T000000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:1-hour planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol.
LOCATION:Conference Room
ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:carol@example.com
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
echo "=== file ==="
cat meeting_scheduled.ics
echo "=== checks ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('meeting_scheduled.ics')
t=p.read_text()
assert t.startswith('BEGIN:VCALENDAR') and t.strip().endswith('END:VCALENDAR')
assert 'VERSION:2.0' in t and 'PRODID:' in t
assert 'BEGIN:VEVENT' in t and 'END:VEVENT' in t
for e in ['alice@example.com','bob@example.com','carol@example.com']:
    assert e in t
assert 'DTSTART:20240117T110000Z' in t and 'DTEND:20240117T120000Z' in t
print('All ICS checks passed')
PY
EOF
